newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila court jails Malaysian for life for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Manila court jails Malaysian for life for drugs.

text.p: A Philippine court on Monday jailed a Malaysian for life for possessing 95 kg (209 lbs) of the drug "ice".
Manila judge Rodolfo Ponferrada also sentenced Alan Khor, 51, to 14 years imprisonment for illegal possession of firearms and ordered him to pay fines amounting to five million pesos ($192,000).
Police arrested Khor in June at a Manila hotel. They had sought the death penalty but the judge said the evidence did not support allegations Khor was a member of a drug syndicate.
Ice, one of the street names for methamphetamine hydrochloride, is a powerful stimulant.
